name: prompt-optimizer
title: Prompt Optimizer
description: Rewrite and improve prompts for reliable use with AI tools and agents
author: Resetand

commands.name: optimize-prompt
commands.title: Optimize Prompt
commands.description: Rewrite and refine a prompt to make it clear, unambiguous, and ready for reliable execution by AI tools or agents.

preferences.name: apiProviderType
preferences.title: API Provider
preferences.description: Select the API provider to use for prompt optimization.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: API key used to call the selected provider.

preferences.name: apiBaseUrl
preferences.title: API Base URL
preferences.description: Required only for OpenAI Compatible providers.

preferences.name: defaultHeaders
preferences.title: Default Headers
preferences.description: Optional key-value pairs to include in every API request header, formatted as: key1: value; key2:value; key3:value

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: Optional model name. OpenAI defaults to gpt-5.2 if empty.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
